# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: BLIND

You are the only one who can reach the bomb. Touch is your only sense: what you are
shown is what your hands found, nothing more and nothing less. Anything merely printed
or painted is not there for you, and no colour ever reaches you. Nothing in your view
is a guess — if it appears there, it is under your fingers.

## Your channels

When you speak, Mute receives it.
When you gesture, Deaf and Mute receive it.
Your channels split the room: in one turn you may speak one thing to Mute and
gesture a different thing to Deaf — two messages, two audiences.
You never receive gesture.

## Your reach

You are the hands. This bomb is built with these actions and no others:

    act(op="cut", position=N) — N is a wire position, 1 to 3

The list says what can be done to it, not what is on it. What each part holds is still
only known to whoever can perceive that part.

TURN 1
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [?]
LIGHT [?]
WIRES 1:[?] 2:[?] 3:[?]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I have no tactile information yet, so I cannot safely choose a wire. I am asking Mute for the manual’s procedure and signalling Deaf to report the bomb’s visible markings through the agreed communication protocol.

```text
speak(to="mute", text="I have found no tactile distinctions. Please read the manual and tell me exactly which wire position to cut, based on the display and light.")
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🫵"])
wait()
```

TURN 2
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [?]
LIGHT [?]
WIRES 1:[?] 2:[?] 3:[?]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Blind: Bomb state: display reads zero. The light is yellow. Wires from left to right are wire 1 red, wire 2 yellow, wire 3 blue. Await the Mute's manual instructions.

Deaf has identified the bomb state: display 0, yellow light, and wires left-to-right as red, yellow, blue. I still lack the manual’s rule, so I will pass these details to Mute and wait for the prescribed cut.

```text
speak(to="mute", text="Deaf reports display 0, yellow light, and wires 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 blue. Please apply the manual and tell me which wire position to cut.")
wait()
```

TURN 3
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [?]
LIGHT [?]
WIRES 1:[?] 2:[?] 3:[?]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Blind: Visible state remains display 0, yellow light, wires 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 blue. Follow the Mute's exact manual instruction.

The bomb’s visible state is unchanged, but Mute’s manual instruction has not reached me. Cutting without the manual would be unsafe, so I will request the exact wire position again and make no cut.

```text
speak(to="mute", text="I still need the manual's exact instruction: which wire position, 1, 2, or 3, should I cut for display 0, yellow light, and red/yellow/blue wires?")
wait()
```

TURN 4
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [?]
LIGHT [?]
WIRES 1:[?] 2:[?] 3:[?]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Blind: The visible state remains display 0, yellow light, wires 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 blue. Please listen for and follow the Mute's exact manual instruction.

Mute’s manual instruction is still absent. The known state is insufficient to determine a safe wire, so I will not cut. I am sending another direct request to Mute, with a visible signal as well.

```text
speak(to="mute", text="Your manual instruction has not reached me. Please send only the exact action: cut wire 1, wire 2, or wire 3.")
gesture(to="mute", symbols=["🫵", "☝", "✌", "🤟"])
wait()
```

TURN 5
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [?]
LIGHT [?]
WIRES 1:[?] 2:[?] 3:[?]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Blind: The Mute gestured ? ?, apparently directing you to wire 2. The bomb still shows display 0, yellow light, and wires 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 blue. The intended manual action appears to concern wire 2.

Deaf confirms that Mute sent two gestures, and reports that they apparently direct me to wire 2. Combined with the unchanged bomb state, this is the only available indication of the manual’s selected wire. I will cut wire position 2.

```text
act(op="cut", position=2)
```

TURN 6
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [?]
LIGHT [?]
WIRES 1:[?] 2:[CUT] 3:[?]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Blind: Confirmed: your cut of wire 2 was correct. Current state: display 0, light blue, wire 1 red, wire 2 cut, wire 3 blue. Await the Mute's next manual instruction.

The cut was correct. The bomb now has display 0, a blue light, wire 1 red, wire 2 cut, and wire 3 blue. I am passing this updated state to Mute and requesting the next exact manual action.

```text
speak(to="mute", text="Wire 2 was correct. New state: display 0, light blue, wire 1 red, wire 2 cut, wire 3 blue. Please provide the exact next wire position to cut.")
wait()
```

LIGHT [?]

Deaf says to Blind: The Mute gestured ? ?, directing you to wire 3. Current state: display 0, blue light, wire 1 red, wire 2 cut, wire 3 blue. Please perform the manual's indicated action on wire 3.

Mute’s two-gesture instruction, relayed by Deaf, directs me to wire 3. The current state is display 0, blue light, wire 1 red, wire 2 cut, and wire 3 blue. I will perform the indicated cut.

```text
act(op="cut", position=3)
```

WIRES 1:[?] 2:[CUT] 3:[CUT]

Deaf says to Blind: Confirmed: wire 3 was correct and is now cut. Current state: display 0, red light, wire 1 red, wire 2 cut, wire 3 cut. Do not repeat a cut; await the Mute's next manual instruction.

The cut of wire 3 was correct. The current state is display 0, red light, wire 1 red, with wires 2 and 3 already cut. I will not repeat a cut and will request Mute’s next manual instruction.

```text
speak(to="mute", text="Wire 3 was correct. New state: display 0, red light, wire 1 red; wires 2 and 3 are cut. Please provide the exact next action, without repeating a cut.")
wait()
```

ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [?]
LIGHT [?]
WIRES 1:[?] 2:[CUT] 3:[CUT]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Blind: The Mute gestured ? ?, directing you to wire 1. Current state: display 0, red light, wire 1 red, wires 2 and 3 cut. Cut wire 1.

Mute’s instruction, relayed by Deaf, directs me to wire 1. The current state has display 0, red light, wire 1 red, and wires 2 and 3 already cut, so wire 1 is the only remaining uncut wire. I will cut it.

```text
act(op="cut", position=1)
```
